scenes.line1: Can you name all 6 STRIDE threats?
scenes.say: Think you can list every STRIDE threat off the top of your head? Which one do you usually miss?

scenes.label: Spoofing
scenes.sub: Pretending to be someone else in the system.
scenes.say: Spoofing means an attacker pretends to be someone else. Think fake logins or forged identities.

The rest of STRIDE: tampering is changing data, repudiation is denying actions, information disclosure is leaking secrets, denial of service is breaking features, and elevation of privilege is gaining extra rights.

left.title: Tampering
items: Altering a request to get admin access

scenes.say: For example, tampering could be changing a request to get admin access. Information disclosure? Sending passwords without encryption.

scenes.question: Is STRIDE just for login features?
scenes.right: No, use STRIDE for every system part.
scenes.say: Don't fall for this: STRIDE isn't just for logins. Use it to check every part of your system.
